name.description: Kebab-case identifier — used to invoke skill from IDE. Must be unique within skills directory.

title.description: Human-readable skill title in Vietnamese. Shown in IDE dropdown.

description.description: One-line summary (1-2 sentences) of what the skill does. Shown in IDE list/dropdown.

version.description: Semantic versioning (1.0.0). Bump when prompt/behavior changes.

scope.description: List of AI IDEs/CLIs this skill is designed for

procedure.description: ETV Procedure number (e.g. 'ETV.P14') if skill implements a procedure. Leave empty for generic skills (Mẫu B).

author.description: Email or name of skill author/maintainer (optional)

created_at.description: ISO 8601 date when skill was created (optional)

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when skill was last updated (optional)

supported_languages.description: Languages this skill is designed to work with

requires_authentication.description: Whether skill needs API keys or credentials

handles_sensitive_data.description: Whether skill processes personal/confidential data — must comply with data protection rules
